Awesome, happy to help you get started! Here’s the simple path:

Sign up & trial: Create an account and we’ll build a custom meal plan for your dog. Your first delivery is a 2‑week trial, then orders ship every 4 weeks.
Set up your pup: Add your dog’s details (age, weight, activity, goals) so we can dial in portion sizes.

Transition slowly: Start by mixing about 25% Nom Nom with 75% current food, then gradually increase over a week until you’re at 100% Nom Nom.
Manage your subscription: From your Account you can adjust orders, delivery timing, address, and payment anytime—as long as it’s before the next order deadline.

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here’s a super simple breakdown of your main options with us:

Start a trial: Sign up, we build a custom plan, you get a 2‑week trial, then it rolls into a recurring order every 4 weeks.
Tweak the meal plan: On your Pets page, you can change recipes, rotate flavors, pick full or half portions, and adjust how many meal packs per day.
Check and manage your account: In your account you can see what’s in each order, change delivery timing/address, and view payment info and past charges.
Portion and feeding info: Each dog’s profile shows recipes and portion sizes, plus a Feeding Guide so you always know how much to serve.
Add extras: On the Extras page, you can add treats and probiotics as a one‑time add-on or every box on repeat.
Add or remove dogs: You can add new dogs and build their meal plans yourself. To remove a dog from the plan, we currently ask that you chat with a Pet Support Specialist.
Try samples without a subscription: You can buy a Variety Pack or single packs through Chewy, Amazon, and PetSmart to test recipes before starting a subscription.
Buy without subscribing: You can also just buy our recipes (and extras like treats and probiotics) from retailers like PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy instead of having a subscription.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
